pipelines.name: Main and Pull Request Pipeline

steps.name: Check for changes
steps.run:
# Check if any docs have been modified
changed_files=$(git ls-files --others --modified --deleted --exclude-standard)

# If there are files changed, fail the workflow
if [ -n "$changed_files" ]; then
  echo "file changes found"
  echo "please check if docs were added for new commands or updated for new commands"
  echo "$changed_files"
  exit 1  # This will fail the workflow
else
  echo "No file changes found."
fi

steps.name: Generate lint summary
steps.run:
echo "

📝 Lint results

" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY cat golangci-lint.report >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY # Check if the lint report contains any content (error or issues) if [ -s golangci-lint.report ]; then # If the file contains content, output an error message and exit with code 1 echo "⚠️ Linting issues found!" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY exit 1 fi
